attchmntText: Bannari Amman Sugars Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bannari Amman Sugars Limited submitted its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 11th November 2026 following a review by the Audit Committee. Statutory auditors P.N. Raghavendra Rao & Co issued a limited review report on the same date. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, the company reported a net profit of 2752.44 Lakhs. Revenue from operations stood at 57165.16 Lakhs. Earnings per share were 15.98. Total assets as at 30th September 2026 were 226106.16 Lakhs. The company has no subsidiary, associate, or joint venture entities for this period.
